FULL TEXT:
Page 1 of 1
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Panjab University
Science Block-II, Sector-25, Chandigarh-160014
Corrigendum-1
Date: 21.11.2025
ADVT. NO. JRF- 06/01/2025
ADVERTISEMENT FOR JRF UNDER ANRF SPONSORED PROJECT
This is w. r. t. the advertisement for appointment of JRFs under ANRF sponsored project entitled
"Dynamic Research Ecosystem for Advanced Materials (DREAMS)" (date 27-10-2025) under
PAIR scheme on a purely temporary (co-terminus with the project). Please note the below
information:
1. The last date for submitting the application is extended to 01 December 2025.
2. The candidates having qualified M. Sc. degree in Applied Sciences with at least 55 % marks may
also apply.
Important Note: The other eligibility criteria and terms & conditions remain unchanged (please refer
to earlier notification/advertisement: ADVT. NO. JRF- 06/01/2025 dated 27.10.2025).
Sd/
Dr. Jadab Sharma
Principal Investigator of PAIR project (PU) &
Chairperson
Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology
Note: The short listed candidates duly recommended by Screening/Selection Committee will be
called for an interview through email. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the
candidates through e-mail/telephonically. Outstation candidates may be allowed to appear in the
interview through video conferencing on prior request. No Transport Allowance (TA) will be paid
for attending the interview.
How to apply:
Interested candidates may email their applications in a single pdf file with detailed biodata (including
contact number and email address) and copies of mark sheets and relevant certificates to
cnsnt@pu.ac.in by 01 December 2025 (advanced copy only). Hard copies of the application must be
submitted to the office by post/hand. Application form can be found at department website:
https://nsnt.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?2025&nbid=47&id=84775
Note: The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email only along with the interview date.
